payload.title: Bind console Google sign-in evidence to central cross-app identity
payload.description: Ryan authorized local cross-app Google identity implementation through parent. Coordinate exact challenge/session evidence contract with Prospectus owner before coding. Preserve code+PKCE+browser-bound one-use state+nonce. Keep independent ID/access evidence server-side only; no token browser storage/logs, no email merge, and identities array alone never proves current Google login. Central owner handles Google issuer/sub to canonical Person plus pool aliases and ambiguity fail-closed. Synthetic specs: two registered pools same Google subject retain account continuity, wrong issuer/client/pair/nonce/replay rejected. Related local console story decision-flywheel-73a50b5e-7f10-4908-aed5-45f87e02da28 and central initiative kanbus-4b25e22d-e764-419d-bd5e-dcb2ce05f5d9. No storage adapter/hosting, EC2/IAM/OAuth grants/DNS or public push.
